# HOA.Help

> HOA and condo association management for self-managed boards across Chicago, Rosemont, Schiller Park and Illinois. Assessment collections, financials, owner portal, reserve-first budgeting, vendor coordination and 24/7 live support. Plans start at $250 per month for basic financials, with a written quote after a free financial and issues review.

## Services
- [Condo management in Chicago](https://www.hoa.help/condo-management-chicago): full-service management for Chicago condominium associations, from high-rises to vintage walk-ups.
- [Association management in Chicago](https://www.hoa.help/association-management-chicago): HOA and townhome association management with documented bids and reserve-first budgets.
- [HOA accounting services](https://www.hoa.help/services/hoa-accounting): collections, bill pay, monthly financials and reserve tracking.
- [Self-managed HOA support](https://www.hoa.help/services/self-managed-hoa-support): hybrid support for boards that keep decisions and hand over administration.

## Guides
- [HOA and condo management in Chicago: a board member's guide](https://www.hoa.help/hoa-management-guide-chicago): scope, costs, choosing a manager and switching.
- [How to switch HOA management companies in Chicago](https://www.hoa.help/how-to-switch-hoa-management-chicago): notice, records, bank accounts, owner communication, first 30 days.
- [Special assessments in Illinois HOAs and condos](https://www.hoa.help/special-assessments-hoa-illinois): how boards approve one, how the amount is split, payment options.
- [HOA reserve studies in Illinois](https://www.hoa.help/hoa-reserve-study-illinois): components, funding targets, percent funded, update cadence.
- [HOA management cost in Chicago](https://www.hoa.help/hoa-management-cost-chicago): pricing models, what changes a quote, contract red flags.

## Service areas
Chicago, Rosemont, Schiller Park, Evanston, Skokie, Schaumburg, Arlington Heights, Palatine and more of Illinois (Illinois only).
